Loading packages and data
```{r}
# Load packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(DEXSeq)

# Locate the shared data folder
data_dir <- if (dir.exists("../Data/raw")) {
  "../Data/raw"
} else {
  "Data/raw"
}

# Load GSE130967 isoform counts and metadata
iso_vivo <- readRDS(
  file.path(data_dir, "data_in_vivo_iso.rds")
)

meta_vivo <- readRDS(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_in_vivo.rds")
)

# Inspect dimensions
dim(iso_vivo)
dim(meta_vivo)
```

```{r}

# Check the current R environment
R.version.string

# Show available package libraries
.libPaths()

# Check whether DEXSeq is available
requireNamespace("DEXSeq", quietly = TRUE)

```

Inspecting samples and metadata
```{r}

# Inspect isoform and sample identifiers
head(rownames(iso_vivo))
head(colnames(iso_vivo))

# Inspect available metadata
head(meta_vivo)
str(meta_vivo)

# Count samples in each smoking group
table(meta_vivo$smoking)

# Check the distribution of sex between groups
table(meta_vivo$smoking, meta_vivo$sex)

# Summarise age
summary(meta_vivo$age)

```

Making sure data and metadata align - we should receive True at the end
```{r}

# Check whether every count-matrix sample
# has a matching metadata entry
all(colnames(iso_vivo) %in% rownames(meta_vivo))

# Check for duplicated sample identifiers
anyDuplicated(colnames(iso_vivo))
anyDuplicated(rownames(meta_vivo))

# Reorder metadata to match the count matrix
meta_vivo <- meta_vivo[
  colnames(iso_vivo), ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Verify exact alignment
identical(
  colnames(iso_vivo),
  rownames(meta_vivo)
)
```

Load gene-to-isoform annotation
```{r}

# Load the annotation data
isoInfo <- readRDS(
  paste0(
    "/home/projects/22140/exam_data/",
    "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds"
  )
)

# Inspect annotation structure
dim(isoInfo)
colnames(isoInfo)
head(isoInfo)

# Match isoforms to their genes
tx_info <- isoInfo[
  match(rownames(iso_vivo), isoInfo$transcript_id),
  c("transcript_id", "gene_id")
]

# Check whether any isoforms lack a gene mapping
sum(is.na(tx_info$gene_id))

# Inspect the matched annotations
head(tx_info)

```

Preparing sample metadata

```{r}

# Confirm that sample IDs are correctly aligned
stopifnot(all(colnames(iso_vivo) == rownames(meta_vivo)))

# Create a sample identifier for DEXSeq
meta_vivo$sample <- factor(rownames(meta_vivo))

# Set nonsmokers as the reference group
meta_vivo$smoking <- relevel(
  factor(meta_vivo$smoking),
  ref = "nonsmoker"
)

# Ensure sex is a factor
meta_vivo$sex <- factor(meta_vivo$sex)

# Standardise age for the statistical model
meta_vivo$age_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(meta_vivo$age))

# Inspect the prepared metadata
head(meta_vivo)
str(meta_vivo)
```
